verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first platform, and its docs say the APIs give programmatic access to customer, account, payment, card and transaction data, so it can be operated without the UI. Beyond that, the evidence never addresses CI or automation pipelines, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: documented CI/automation guidance, sandbox/test environment for pipelines, CLI or SDK tooling, machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
